name: python-permutations
title: Permutations of Small Lists
blurb: permutations of small lists: every ordering of items is generated, the count equals the factorial, and distinct permutations are deduplicated; oversized or malformed inputs are named, never permuted.
default_description: A permutation generator whose count is the factorial oracle on every small list, whose entries are all true permutations, and whose oversized or malformed inputs are named, never permuted.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a permutation keeps every item exactly once, in a new order
